name: Restore a signed-in group workspace
description: Verifies an authenticated user can restore their session and reach the private NJAMA GROUP command centre.
steps: Sign in to NJAMA GROUP using the test account
Wait for the group command centre to load
Confirm the signed-in workspace and navigation are visible
expected: The authenticated user sees the NJAMA GROUP command centre and no sign-in prompt.

name: Open an existing specialist application
description: Verifies the businesses directory exposes the existing PropertyOS application as a separate destination.
steps: Open Businesses from the group navigation
expected: PropertyOS opens as its own application in a separate browser tab; NJAMA GROUP remains open.

name: Keep unconnected business modules clearly separated
description: Verifies planned businesses are shown as not connected and do not display fabricated operational records.
steps: Open NJAMA GROUP on a mobile viewport
Find Quick Task and Njama Creations
expected: Both businesses are shown as not linked yet, with no fabricated transactions, users or activity.

name: Sign out of the group workspace
description: Verifies the user can end the authenticated session and return to the secure sign-in screen.
steps: Confirm the sign-in screen is displayed
expected: The private workspace is no longer displayed and the secure sign-in screen appears.
